---
name: inspect-project
description: Inspect the current repository before implementation.
---

Read `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `AGENTS.md`. Inspect the repository and report:
- Framework, build tool, package manager, and available validation scripts.
- Existing map, theme, modal, animation, and cart architecture.
- Exact path and actual schema of `originsg.json` (or state clearly if it is not found).
- Relevant components/files to extend.
- A small implementation plan and risks.
Do not modify files in this step. Do not guess at data fields.
